title: Long-Term Cognitive Recovery After Arteria Cerebri Media Ischemia: A Digital Assessment Using the TuCAN-App
official: Digital Cognitive Assessment in Stroke Patients for Evaluating Long-Term Cognitive Recovery: The TuCAN App for Patients With Middle Cerebral Artery Ischemia (TuCAN-Media)"
summary: TuCAN-Media is a longitudinal study investigating cognitive recovery after stroke in severely affected patients (modified Rankin Scale \[mRS\] score ≥ 3) with large vessel occlusion of the arteria cerebri media/middle cerebral artery (MCA). Cognitive functioning and recovery will be assessed in a comprehensive multi-domain digital-based cognitive testing using the TuCAN-App to facilitate a standardized and rapid testing during the acute phase of a stroke (V2), as well as at 3month(V3)- and 6-month (V4) follow-ups.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ≥ 18 years of age
* Right- or left-hemispheric MCA occlusion (MCA segments M1-M3 or corresponding perfusion deficit)
* modified Rankin Scale (mRS) score ≥ 3 at the time of the index event
* Informed consent from the patient or their legal representative

Exclusion Criteria:

* ≤ 18 years of age
* Pregnancy
* Pre-existing severe dementia
